extraFacts.fact: The O-ring face seal (ORFS, SAE J1453 / ISO 8434-3) uses a flat-faced male end whose face carries an O-ring, sealed against the flat face of a female swivel nut; ORS is Eaton Aeroquip's name for it and flat face is Dixon's.
extraFacts.source: SAE J1453 / ISO 8434-3; Eaton Aeroquip and Dixon catalogues

extraFacts.fact: ASME B1.20.3 (Dryseal NPTF) is the pipe thread standard for NPTF threads, which seal on the taper with sealant.
